systems.system: electronic Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (eIDSR)
systems.owner: Ministry of Health and National Public Health Agency, with WHO and AFENET technical support
systems.tiers: over 1,500 public and private health facilities in all 16 districts, reporting weekly from mobile devices to district and national levels; fully rolled out 2019; share of facilities submitting weekly rose from 70% to an anticipated 85% after troubleshooting in May-June 2025

note: The whole document is about eIDSR, a weekly disease-surveillance application: single-function under the typology, so it gives no HMIS fact although it is DHIS2-based and entered at the facility. Nothing on routine service reporting or patient records.
